definition: a clearing of one's dues, loan etc. payable to another.
example: ಸಾಲ ತೀರಿಸಿ ಜಾಡೆ ಮುಗಿಸಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: He felt relieved after clearing his debt and settling the dues.

definition: a younger brother.
example_en: Her younger brother passed the examination.

definition: a tiger, as an enemy of deers.
example_en: The tiger, enemy of the deer, was terrifying the deer in the forest.

definition: the state or quality of being in harmony with; an orderly agreement.
example_en: An orderly agreement came about between the two factions.

definition: that which is got, earned.
example_en: This is the earnings of his labor.

definition: a thing achieved, esp. by skill, work, courage, etc.; achievement.
example_en: His achievement earned everyone's admiration.

definition: to miss the road, course (while going from one place to another).
example_en: We lost the way in the forest and missed the road.

definition: a woman who is very much interested in or desirous of, having sexual relation (with a man).
example: ಆಕೆಯನ್ನು ಊರಿನ ಜನ ಕಡುವೇಟಗಾರ್ತಿ ಎಂದು ಜರಿಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The people of the town scorned her as a woman overly desirous of sexual relations.

definition: that which is acquired, gained by practice.
example_en: This skill is his knowledge acquired through practice.

definition: a gathering, collection of people, things or animals.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ದಿನ ಜನರ ಸಂಚಯ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡುಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: On the festival day, a gathering of people was seen at the temple.

definition: the act or an instance of shaving the hair.
example_en: The barber carried out the shaving of the hair with care.

definition: Śiva.
example_en: Devotees worship Sabba as Śiva.

definition: to become inflated; to swell.
example_en: The balloon swelled up as it was filled with air.

definition: the indistinct murmuring sound.
example_en: An indistinct murmuring sound of people was heard from a distance.

definition: a room or a building where patients are treated by a physician and medicines are given or prescribed; a clinic.
example_en: They took the patient to the clinic for treatment.

definition: to grin showing both the rows of teeth, one placed on the other firmly.
example: ಅವನು ಹಲ್ಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಕಚ್ಚಿ ಗಿಟಗಿರಿಯುತ್ತಾ ಸಿಟ್ಟಿನಿಂದ ನೋಡಿದನು.
example_en: He looked on angrily, gritting and grinning his clenched teeth.

definition: a kind of silk cloth.
example_en: There were colourful nerravatte silk sarees in the shop.

definition: a seasoning of food with oil, spices, asafoetida, etc.
example_en: He added seasoning to the sambar and mixed it well.

definition: the state of being cut, broken or minced into small piece.
example_en: When struck with a stone, the bottle shattered into small pieces.

definition: to abuse; to use indecent and offensive language.
example_en: The drunkard abused people in the street with indecent language.

definition: a liquid injected into the body; injection.
example_en: The doctor gave the patient an injection.

definition: an old crow.
example_en: The old crow was sitting on the tree.

definition: a man of excellence, eminence or noble quality.
example: ಆ ಉನ್ನತ ತನ್ನ ಜ್ಞಾನದಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗೌರವ ಗಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That eminent man earned everyone's respect through his knowledge.

definition: the tendency of disliking or avoiding work; laziness.
example_en: His laziness, the tendency to avoid work, had become a trouble for his family.

definition: a cow.
example_en: That cow gives milk every day.

definition: the sorrel plant Oxalis latifolia of Oxalidaceae family; Indian sorrel.
example_en: She added Indian sorrel to the cooking.

definition: a heap of sand; a dune.
example: ಕಡಲ ತೀರದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಣಲ್ದಿಂಟೆ ಗಾಳಿಗೆ ಆಕಾರ ಬದಲಿಸುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: On the seashore, the sand dune kept changing shape with the wind.

definition: (pros.) a metre having three rhyming lines.
example: ಆ ಕವಿ ತ್ರಿವುಡೆ ಛಂದಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪದ್ಯ ರಚಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That poet composed the verse in the trivude metre.

definition: to cause to fade, wane; to make a thing listless.
example_en: The heat caused the flowers to fade.

definition: a particular disposition or bent of mind; preference.
example_en: Her preference was toward music.

definition: a kind of pudding baked in steam.
example_en: Grandmother made hot steamed pudding in the morning.

definition: the basic metric unit of linear measure, equal to 100 cms.
example_en: That cloth is two meters long.

definition: to move (oneself); to change one's position.
example_en: The injured animal slowly moved itself.

definition: the act of closing and opening of the eyelids.
example_en: When the light fell on her, her blinking (eyelid movement) increased.

definition: a servant in a formal official uniform.
example: ಆ ಢಳಾಯತ ಸಮವಸ್ತ್ರ ಧರಿಸಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That uniformed servant was working wearing his uniform.

definition: any bacterial toxin mixed with one's food with the intention of causing sickness; food-poison.
example_en: It was discovered that food-poison had been mixed into the cooking.

definition: calcium oxide (CaO) containing calcium carbonate, that boils when water is added.
example_en: When water was added, the quicklime boiled up.

definition: a room or place equipped for cooking; a kitchen.
example_en: The cook was cooking in the kitchen.

definition: the very first model, mould to mould something.
example: ಕೆತ್ತನೆಗಾರನು ತಾಯಿ ಅಚ್ಚಿನಿಂದ ಹೊಸ ಮೂರ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಎರಕಹೊಯ್ದನು.
example_en: The sculptor cast a new idol from the mother mould.

definition: the left-over in a dining plate; anything that has come into contact with the mouth, tongue or teeth or the hands of the person while taking food (considered defiled).
example_en: One should not let others touch a plate with leftover food.

definition: any heart disease.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಹೃದಯಶೂಲೆ ಇರುವುದರಿಂದ ಆಗಾಗ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: Since he has a heart disease, he often goes to the hospital.

definition: an unambiguous, clear and straight speech; a word or communication that is clear, definite in its meaning.
example_en: He always speaks in a clear, unambiguous manner.

definition: to rush, act suddenly with little thought; to move (forward) with great force or violence; to be furious.
example_en: The soldiers rushed furiously and charged toward the enemy fort.

definition: an upright post with a bar across it near the top, on which, in ancient times, convicted persons were fastened or nailed to die; a cross.
example_en: She was wearing a gold cross around her neck.

definition: encroached; appended (illegally).
example: ಆ ಜಾಗ ಮನೆಗೆ ವಾಢಾವಾ ಆಗಿ ಸೇರಿಕೊಂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That plot had been illegally appended to the house.

definition: a very hot summer.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಬೆಟ್ಟಬೇಸಗೆ ಜನರನ್ನು ತತ್ತರಿಸುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: This year the extremely hot summer made people suffer.

definition: the tree Rhododendron nilagiricum of Ericaceae family.
example: ನೀಲಗಿರಿ ಬೆಟ್ಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಡುಹೂವರಸಿ ಮರಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: The Rhododendron nilagiricum trees grow abundantly in the Nilgiri hills.

definition: one of the branches of the primary root of a plant.
example_en: Many small roots branched out from the plant's root.

definition: a sharp, piercing cry; scream; shriek.
example_en: The woman let out a shriek upon seeing the snake.

definition: a holy place in Gaya, in Bihar.
example_en: The pilgrims worshipped the Vishnupada at Gaya.

definition: the typical sewing-machine stitch formed by the interlocking of two threads; lock stitch.
example_en: The blouse was firmly stitched with a lock stitch.

definition: a register in which accounts of income and expenditure are maintained; an accounts register.
example_en: The clerk recorded all the transactions in the accounts register.

definition: a handsome man.
example_en: In the village, he is famous as a handsome man.

definition: to jump, fall on (an object as in attacking).
example_en: The tiger pounced on the deer.

definition: the act of tying, binding together.
example: ಆ ಪುರೋಹಿತ ಹೂವುಗಳನ್ನು ಗ್ರಂಥ ಮಾಡಿ ಮಾಲೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿದ.
example_en: That priest tied the flowers together to make a garland.

definition: a man inclined to have company or companionship of others (esp. of bad people).
example: ಸಂಗತಿರಕ್ತನಾದ ಅವನು ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಜನರ ಜೊತೆ ಸೇರಿದನು.
example_en: Being a man fond of company, he joined bad people.

definition: to divide (something) and distribute among and get a share.
example_en: The brother and sister divided the sweets and took their share.

definition: to cause to dangle from one side to the other.
example: ಗಾಳಿಗೆ ಬಾಗಿಲು ಬೀರಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಜೋರಾಗಿ ಶಬ್ದ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The door swung to and fro in the wind, making a loud noise.

definition: to become very happy, delighted.
example_en: Hearing the result, she became very happy and delighted.

definition: a fine, mistlike rain.
example_en: In the morning, the fine mist-like rain had settled on the leaves.

definition: ( in comparative degree) of a more excellent sort; surpassing another or others; more suitable, more desirable, more favorable, more profitable, etc.
example_en: This route is more suitable than that route.

definition: a man given to earn more and more money in life.
example_en: The money-grubber strives to earn more money.

definition: a bird, akin to crow, resembling the pheasant; a crow-pheasant.
example_en: The crow-pheasant was sitting near the paddy field.

definition: that which causes complete destruction or has the tendency to do so.
example_en: That earthquake caused complete destruction to the whole city.

definition: the narrowed part of the body between the thorax and hips; the waist.
example_en: The dancer's waist was slender and beautiful.

definition: a deep spot in a river having a whirlpool.
example_en: The water is very deep at the deep whirlpool spot in the river.

definition: the time from sunset to sunrise; a night.
example_en: During that night, the whole town was silent.

definition: a woman who washes clothes, linens, etc., for hire; a laundryman; a washerwoman.
example: ಮಡಿವಳತಿ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಒಗೆಯಲು ಬರುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: The washerwoman comes every morning to wash clothes.

definition: any of several hard or semisolid materials obtained as a tarlike residue in the distillation of petroleum, coal tar, wood tar, etc.; bitumen.
example: ಶಿಲಾಜತು ಪೆಟ್ರೋಲಿಯಂ ಬಟ್ಟಿ ಇಳಿಸುವಿಕೆಯ ಶೇಷ ಪದಾರ್ಥವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: Bitumen is a residue substance obtained from the distillation of petroleum.

definition: a direction, in the compass, between two main directions; any of the four directions, south-east, south-west, north-west and north-east.
example_en: This temple is in the south-east direction.

definition: a seeing, observing by oneself.
example_en: Only two people directly observed the incident.

definition: regulating; governing; controlling.
example: ಸಂಚಾರ ಪೊಲೀಸನು ರಸ್ತೆಯ ವಾಹನಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತೃ ಶಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ನಡೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: The traffic police controlled the vehicles on the road with regulating authority.

definition: a woman who habitually lies; a lier.
example_en: The words of that lying woman have no value in the town.

definition: impetuous force; vehemence.
example_en: The impetuous force of the storm uprooted the trees.

definition: he who or that which raises, lifts, draws or pulls out or is doing so.
example_en: The rescuer drew water from the well.

definition: to come or be lying across as to cause an obstacle; to impede.
example: ಬಿದ್ದ ಮರ ದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡ್ಡಯಿಸಿ ಜನರ ಸಂಚಾರಕ್ಕೆ ತೊಂದರೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: The fallen tree lay across the road and obstructed people's movement.

definition: a man who inhabits some specified region, dwelling, etc.; an inhabitant.
example_en: All the inhabitants of that village were farmers.

definition: an offering of a kind of cake as an oblation to the mother-earth, as a thanksgiving gesture, while harvesting.
example_en: During the harvest season they offered the cake oblation in the field.

definition: to put (oneself) into strenuous, vigorous action or effort; to exert; to labour; to toil.
example_en: The farmers toil in the field.

definition: regarded with a good, favourable opinion, judgement.
example_en: This plan came to be regarded favourably among the people.

definition: the line where the sky seems to meet the earth; horizon.
example_en: The ship disappeared beyond the horizon.

definition: a kind of jasmine.
example_en: The jasmine flowers in the garden were spreading fragrance.

definition: one who cheats others; a cheat; deceiver.
example_en: Do not trust a cheat like him.

definition: the raised chest (as from pride, jubilation, etc.).
example_en: His chest was raised with the joy of victory.

definition: the fact or condition of doing, performing, occuring in the presence (of someone).
example_en: He conducted the inquiry in the king's presence.

definition: a mixture of pieces of areca and cashew nuts.
example_en: They served the guests a mixture of areca pieces and cashew nuts.

definition: an untamed horse.
example_en: The untamed horse did not let anyone come near it.

definition: an able, strong woman.
example_en: The strong woman toiled in the field on par with the men.

definition: one's own mother.
example_en: One's own mother will not leave her child.

definition: of greater than usual or standard length or height; longer or too long; lengthy.
example_en: Her lengthy hair fell down to her back.

definition: the tree Santalum album ( = Sirium myrtifolium) of Santalaceae family, known for its sweet smelling heartwood; sandalwood.
example_en: They ground the sandalwood and prepared sandal paste.

definition: to pick up; to take up one by one (from a lot).
example_en: The hen picked up the grains on the ground.

definition: neat orderly or trim, clearly organised.
example_en: Her house is always kept neat and orderly.

definition: to manifest in a physical form.
example_en: The goddess manifested in physical form before the devotee.

definition: a beast; an animal.
example_en: A beast was running in the forest.

definition: to lose one's patience or composure.
example_en: Irritated by the noise, she lost her composure.

definition: the site of battle; a battle-field.
example_en: The two armies faced each other on the battlefield.

definition: a good city or town.
example_en: It was famed as a peaceful, good town.

definition: any of the lotus plants.
example_en: Lotus flowers were floating all over the lake.

definition: of that type, manner or mode.
example_en: I will never do such work.

definition: a person who travels; a traveller.
example_en: That traveller came to a new town.

definition: a man who compels another (for doing or restraining from doing something); compeller.
example_en: That compeller forced everyone into the work.

definition: (pl.) the festivals or festival days.
example_en: They celebrated the festivals in the village with joy.

definition: skill in using one's hands; dexterity; facility.
example_en: The sculptor has dexterity in carving.

definition: to pose an impediment; to obstruct.
example_en: That group obstructed our plan.

definition: in or during the intervening time; mean-time.
example_en: In the meantime it rained and everyone got wet.

definition: prominent; principal; pre-eminent.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಗ್ರ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಪಡೆದಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: He has attained a pre-eminent position in his field.

definition: pertaining to or performed by mathematical functions; functional.
example: ಈ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗೆ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಕ ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪರಿಹಾರ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿತು.
example_en: A solution to this problem was found through the functional method.

definition: a killing of a brāhmaṇa, considered as one of the five most heinous sins.
example: ಆ ಕಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬ್ರಮಾತಿ ಮಾಡಿದವನಿಗೆ ಘೋರ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: In that story, the one who killed a brāhmaṇa received a terrible punishment.

definition: breakage - a) the act or an instance of breaking; b) a broken thing; c) damage caused by breaking.
example_en: There was a breakage in the leg of the chair.

definition: cool or cold water.
example_en: Tired in the sun, he drank cool water.

definition: (said of cutting weapons) the quality or fact of being blunt.
example_en: The bluntness of the old sword made it useless for work.

definition: a large number of people, animals or things being together; a group; a multitude; a crowd.
example_en: A crowd of people had gathered at the festival.

definition: the condition of death being imminent; the last hours in a person's life.
example: ವೈದ್ಯರು ಅವನದು ಪ್ರತ್ಯಾಸನ್ನಮೃತ್ಯು ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The doctors said his death was imminent.

definition: a pawn known as 'minister' at chess.
example_en: One should not move the minister like a horse.

definition: a kind of lease or land.
example_en: That land has been given on heगalu-gēṇi lease.

definition: not narrow; wide; spacious; not restricted.
example_en: That ground was spread out spaciously.

definition: the state of being related in harmony.
example_en: There was a rare harmony in their friendship.

definition: of, pertaining to or made in China, its people or their languages or culture; Chinese.
example_en: Chinese porcelain vessels are very beautiful.

definition: a river that has no water (as in summer or during drought).
example_en: In summer, that waterless river had dried up.

definition: a man who administers; an executive or official of a business, institution or a government; an administrator.
example: ಆ ಆಡಳಿತೆದಾರ ಶಾಲೆಯ ಎಲ್ಲ ಕೆಲಸಗಳನ್ನು ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: That administrator manages all the school's affairs.

definition: deprived of human inhabitation; desolate.
example_en: No one lived in that desolate land.

definition: indebtedness of an author for other authors whose works had been referred, and opinions, quotations etc. are reproduced.
example_en: The author acknowledged his debt to other works in the preface.

definition: a woman who cheats herself; a self-deceiver.
example_en: That self-deceiving woman does not admit her mistakes.

definition: a minor crop grown between two furrows of the main crop.
example: ಈ ಬಾರಿ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಕಡಿಯಾಗಿ ಹೆಸರುಕಾಳು ಬಿತ್ತಿದ್ದೇವೆ.
example_en: This time we have sown green gram as a minor crop between the furrows of the field.

definition: the central mast of a ship.
example_en: The ship's central mast broke in the storm.

definition: a conical metal piece having large number of votive lamps, for waving before an idol.
example_en: The priests waved the conical lamp-stand (giriyārati) before the idol in the temple.

definition: the movement of an orbiting celestial object, as a star or planet, completely around another object; a revolving or a rovolution.
example: ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಚಂದ್ರನ ಫೇರಿಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಪಾಠ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher taught the students about the moon's revolution.

definition: the act of going up; a climbing, soaring.
example_en: The climb up the hill was very difficult.

definition: the large drape or hanging screen at the front of the stage, which is drawn up or aside to reveal the stage; a curtain.
example_en: They drew the curtain in front of the stage.

definition: water containing mineral salts that make lathering and cleansing properties of soap difficult and also corrode metals; hard-water.
example_en: Soap does not lather well in hard water.

definition: a piece of land higher than adjacent land; a natural elevation of land.
example: ಆ ತಿಂಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಮರ ನಿಂತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A tree stood on that elevated ground.

definition: a master - a) a man who rules others, has control, authority, power over; b) a male head of a household; c) a man in relation to his employees; an employer.
example_en: The master gave wages to his workers.

definition: an eye-witness - a) a person who sees or has seen something happen, as an accident, crime, etc.; b) a person who testifies to what he or she has seen.
example: ಅಪಘಾತಕ್ಕೆ ತೊಡೆಸಕ್ಕಿಯಾಗಿ ಅವನು ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿ ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: As an eye-witness to the accident, he testified in court.

definition: the act of entering; entrance.
example_en: The entrance to the hall was through the door.

definition: a street where shops are located; a market place.
example_en: People were trading on the market street.

definition: any of black, brown or red hymenopteran insects, of Formicidae family, gen. wingless, that live in colonies with a complex division of labour by castes, including workers, males, and a queen; an ant.
example_en: The ants were walking in a line over the sugar.

definition: sharp or sharpened; whetted; keen.
example_en: The blade of the sword was sharpened.

definition: a blemish of a family.
example_en: His bad conduct became a blemish on the family.

definition: a long shaft with a pointed end used for piercing; a spear.
example: ಆ ಯೋಧನು ಸೂನಗೆಯನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿಕೊಂಡು ಮುಂದೆ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: That warrior picked up the spear and came forward.

definition: a kind of ornament for wearing round the wrist.
example_en: She was wearing a beautiful wrist ornament.

definition: the act, practice or an instance of cheating; deception.
example_en: The customers came to know the merchant's deception.

definition: a train carrying goods (as diff. from pssenger trains); a goods-train.
example_en: The goods-train carried goods throughout the night.

definition: a small square, like that of a chessboard, on a fabric as a pattern.
example: ಆ ಸೀರೆಯ ಚಾರ್ಖಾನೆ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ ಬಹಳ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The check pattern of that saree was very beautiful.

definition: to subject to undue strain, difficulty, excessive hardship; etc.; to try.
example_en: The teacher tried the disciple by putting him through great strain.

definition: more or less correct in number, volume, quantity, quality, etc.
example_en: The count was more or less correct.

definition: to have a favourable disposition or bent of mind, will, etc.; to incline; to like.
example_en: His mind inclines towards this work.

definition: a talking lightly or lacking seriousness about the subject (often just for passing time).
example_en: The friends sat chatting lightly in the evening.

definition: the superintendent of horse-keepers.
example_en: The palace's superintendent of horse-keepers looked after the horses.

definition: a female dancer.
example_en: Everyone praised and admired the female dancer.

definition: a narrow, secrete passage.
example_en: There was a narrow, secret passage inside the fort.

definition: the thorny plant Tribulus terrestris of Zygophyllaceae family.
example_en: The Tribulus terrestris is a thorny medicinal plant.

definition: (dial.) a birḍs horny projecting jaws; a bill.
example_en: That bird's bill was sharply curved.

definition: eight times ten; eighty.

example_en: Due to poverty, that family underwent great difficulty.

definition: any eatable in gen.; food.
example_en: They gave the travellers tasty food.

definition: a medicinal oil extracted from a kind of plant.
example_en: She applied the medicinal oil for the body ache.

definition: a musical mode.
example_en: The scholars explained the musical mode Devagupta.

definition: not desired or longed for.
example_en: That position was not desired by him.

definition: a stick or a stick-like part in a machine, that rotates; a rotor.
example_en: The rotor inside the wheel was spinning fast.

definition: a case for a sword; a sheath.
example_en: The warrior put the sword into its sheath.

definition: a man who walks; a walker.
example: ಆ ನಡೆಗ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲೆ ಹತ್ತುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That walker climbs the hill every day.

definition: being five times as much or as many; five-fold.
example_en: One can expect a five-fold profit.

definition: a period of seven days; a week.
example: ಆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಯಲು ಒಂದು ಹಫ್ತೆ ಬೇಕಾಯಿತು.
example_en: It took one week for that work to finish.

definition: a place, an area.
example_en: This place is suitable for worship.

definition: the food of gods; ambrosia.
example_en: The gods became immortal by consuming ambrosia.

definition: genuine friendship.
example_en: There had been genuine friendship between the two of them for a long time.

definition: with a disappointed mood.
example_en: Hearing the result, he smiled with a disappointed mood.

definition: heated or over-heated.
example_en: The iron kept in the sun had become overheated.

definition: an earthen pot.
example_en: An earthen pot was kept in the courtyard of the house.

definition: the food of the gods; ambrosia.
example_en: They say one who drinks the ambrosia does not die.

definition: a man who is faithful to the constituted authority of his country.
example_en: He is a citizen faithful to the country.

definition: (coll.) the palm of the hand hollowed as to hold a small quantity of a liquid.
example_en: He drank water from his cupped palm.

definition: the direction in which sun sets; west.
example_en: The sun was setting in the west direction.

definition: the task for which one is employed; work; occupation; profession; employment.
example_en: He got employment in a government office.

definition: to reach (something) by stretching one's hand.
example_en: She reached the object on top of the shelf by stretching her hand.

definition: to score or mark the surface of with a nail or nails.
example_en: The child scratched the wall with its nails.

definition: the owner of a farm land.
example: ಆ ಹಿಡುವಳಿದಾರ ತನ್ನ ಜಮೀನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಭತ್ತ ಬೆಳೆದನು.
example_en: That landowner grew paddy on his farmland.

definition: a dear son.
example_en: The father affectionately embraced his dear son.

definition: the relation that exists between the support and the supported.
example: ಶಿಕ್ಷಕ ಮತ್ತು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಯ ಆಧಾರಾಧೇಯ ಭಾವ ಮುಖ್ಯವಾದುದು.
example_en: The relation between the supporter and the supported, as of teacher and student, is important.

definition: an arrow.
example_en: The hunter fitted an arrow to the bow.

definition: to be cheated, trapped by another.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿಯ ಮಾತಿಗೆ ನಂಬಿ ಅವನು ಬೇಸ್ತುಬಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: He was cheated after trusting that trader's words.

definition: that which helps understanding the meaning (of something) clearly.
example_en: That explanation clarified the meaning of the poem.

definition: to fall down as to lie horizontally (as on the ground).
example_en: The exhausted traveller fell down under the tree.

definition: to pour without break.
example_en: As the rain poured, the water poured without break.

definition: relating to a conclusion; conjectural.
example_en: His conjectural conclusion turned out to be wrong.

definition: a small hand.
example_en: The child's small hand grasped its mother's finger.

definition: to be available in one's hands; to be got.
example: ಬಹಳ ಹುಡುಕಾಡಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಆ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಕೈಹತ್ತಿತು.
example_en: After a lot of searching, that book was got in hand.

definition: a respectable, dignified man.
example: ಊರಿನ ಜನರು ಅವನನ್ನು ಮಾನಕರಿ ಎಂದು ಗೌರವಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The villagers honoured him as a respectable, dignified man.

definition: he who owes money to another or others; a man in debt; a debtor.
example: ಸಾಲಿಗನಾದ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಬಡ್ಡಿ ಕಟ್ಟುವುದೇ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಹೊರೆಯಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: For him, a debtor, paying the interest was a great burden.

definition: the strong-scented herb Ruta graveolens ( = R. angustifolia) of Rutaceae family, the fragrance of which repels snakes; rue.
example_en: They planted rue around the house.

definition: (pl.) two layers.
example_en: Two layers had been added to this cloth.

definition: an amount deducted by the purchaser from the value while paying cash against a bill of exchange, promissory note, etc. to cover his interest cost for the unexpired period; a discount.
example: ನಗದು ಪಾವತಿಸುವಾಗ ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ವಟ ಕಡಿತಗೊಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: While paying in cash, the shopkeeper deducted a small discount.
